messages:
alex: Nimbus POC blocked: SCIM calls return 403 'token not allowed for tenant' and SAML logins fail with NameID format mismatch. They're on Dedicated + VPC peering. Need triage.
meera: can you drop the last scim-proxy error snippet and the SAML NameID from their assertion? also which token did they paste into the Dedicated console?
sam: logs (redacted):
```
scim-proxy: 403 forbidden - token scope 'hosted' cannot access tenant 'nimbus'
saml-service: NameID Format="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:nameid-format:transient" value="00uZZZ123"
```
meera: classic hosted-vs-dedicated key issue. tenant tokens look like "rudx-tenant-<slug>". Hosted tokens (rudx-xxxxx) will 403 against /dedicated/<tenant>. Also transient NameID means we can't link to SCIM user.
alex: customer pasted 'rudx-8f7e3' into the tenant SCIM field while we were provisioning. They say IdP policy enforces transient NameIDs by default for some apps.
sam: immediate fixes: 1) issue a short-lived tenant token and DM it for provisioning, 2) ask IdP to create a dedicated SAML app for Redwood with NameID=email (or map email into an attribute), 3) verify SCIM base path exactly matches /dedicated/nimbus/Users.
onboard-bot: issued temp token rudx-tenant-temp-nimbus-2h (expires 2160004536) via secure DM.
meera: quick curl test they can run from their network:```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer rudx-tenant-temp-nimbus-2h" \
  https://scim.redwood.company/dedicated/nimbus/Users | jq .
```
alex: ran the test from their environment -> returned 200 + user list. SCIM provisioning resumed.
sam: SAML next: send them our metadata (ACS + Audience). Common IdP issues: trailing slash on ACS, missing Audience value, or NameID format still transient. If their org enforces transient, get them to create a separate app.
meera: small gotcha we hit: Okta sometimes sends emails[0].value. Our SCIM mapping supports both but the customer's connector was using legacy form encoding. We recommended the Okta SCIM template (JSON).
alex: customer says they can't change org-wide transient policy. They created a new SAML app for Redwood and set NameID to emailAddress. After mapping, SAML login succeeded.
onboard-bot: SCIM job 8832 finished: 96 users provisioned, 2 updated, 0 errors.
meera: follow-ups: 1) we'll add a UI validation in Dedicated console to warn when a hosted key pattern is pasted into tenant fields; 2) docs task: add 'Hosted vs Dedicated keys and SCIM path' checklist for onboarding; 3) note for infra: add telemetry for NameID transient vs email detection.
sam: thanks team, Nimbus confirms POC access and login. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
